metadata.description: Fails the run naming every file in apps/web/public that nothing in the web app or its UI packages references (by /public path or file name). The WASM bundle, favicons and robots.txt are served by convention, and dotfiles (Finder's .DS_Store) never ship, so all are skipped. Run it from the repo root.

parameters.script:
# unused-assets: fail naming every file in apps/web/public that nothing in
# the web app or its UI packages references, by its /public path or its file
# name. Each argument is one file, relative to apps/web/public.
# Gap: a content-search node will replace this step (dogfooding.md, PR 9).
referenced() {
  for dir in apps/web/app apps/web/components apps/web/lib packages/ui/src packages/editor/src; do
    if [ -d "$dir" ] && grep -rqF -- "$1" "$dir"; then return 0; fi
  done
  return 1
}

unused=""
for file in "$@"; do
  if ! referenced "/$file" && ! referenced "${file##*/}"; then
    unused="$unused
  apps/web/public/$file"
  fi
done

if [ -n "$unused" ]; then
  echo "Nothing references these files in apps/web/public:$unused" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "Every file in apps/web/public is referenced."
